## AS Level · Chapters 1–11

Choose a chapter to begin. Each page keeps the original English wording and diagrams, with answers from the official mark schemes.

::: {.course-grid .as-level}

::: {.topic-card}
### [1 Physical quantities and units](as-level/01-physical-quantities-and-units.qmd)

- 1.1 Physical quantities: values, units and orders of magnitude
- 1.2 SI units: base units, derived units, dimensional consistency and prefixes
:::

::: {.topic-card}
### [2 Kinematics](as-level/02-kinematics.qmd)

- 2.1 Equations of motion: displacement, velocity, acceleration and motion graphs
- SUVAT equations, free fall and projectile motion
:::

::: {.topic-card}
### [3 Dynamics](as-level/03-dynamics.qmd)

- Newton's laws, force and momentum, terminal velocity
- Momentum conservation and collisions
:::

::: {.topic-card}
### [4 Forces, density and pressure](as-level/04-forces-density-pressure.qmd)

- 4.1 Turning effects: centre of gravity, moment, couple and torque
- 4.2 Equilibrium of forces: principle of moments and vector triangles
- 4.3 Density and pressure: hydrostatic pressure, upthrust and Archimedes' principle
:::

::: {.topic-card}
### [5 Work, energy and power](as-level/05-work-energy-power.qmd)

- 5.1 Energy conservation: work done, efficiency and power
- 5.2 Gravitational potential energy and kinetic energy
:::

::: {.topic-card}
### [6 Deformation of solids](as-level/06-deformation-of-solids.qmd)

- 6.1 Stress and strain: Hooke's law, spring constant and the Young modulus
- 6.2 Elastic and plastic behaviour: stress-strain graphs and strain energy
:::

::: {.topic-card}
### [7 Waves](as-level/07-waves.qmd)

- 7.1 Progressive waves: wave equation, phase difference, intensity and CRO
- 7.2 Transverse and longitudinal waves, Doppler effect for sound
- 7.3 Electromagnetic spectrum, polarisation and Malus's law
:::

::: {.topic-card}
### [8 Superposition](as-level/08-superposition.qmd)

- 8.1 Stationary waves: nodes, antinodes, strings and tubes
- 8.2 Diffraction and interference: double-slit and diffraction grating
:::

::: {.topic-card}
### [9 Electricity](as-level/09-electricity.qmd)

- 9.1 Electric current and p.d.: charge, current, drift velocity and power
- 9.2 Resistance: Ohm's law and I-V characteristics
- 9.3 Resistivity: $\rho=RA/L$ and temperature, illumination and strain
:::

::: {.topic-card}
### [10 D.C. circuits](as-level/10-dc-circuits.qmd)

- 10.1 Practical circuits: e.m.f. vs p.d., internal resistance and power
- 10.2 Kirchhoff's laws: charge and energy conservation, series and parallel
- 10.3 Potential dividers: potentiometer, null methods, thermistors and LDRs
:::

::: {.topic-card}
### [11 Particle physics](as-level/11-particle-physics.qmd)

- 11.1 Atoms, nuclei and radiation: α-scattering, α/β/γ decay and the atomic mass unit
- 11.2 Fundamental particles: quarks, baryons, mesons and leptons
:::

:::

## A Level · Chapters 12–25

::: {.course-grid .a-level}

::: {.topic-card}
### [12 Motion in a circle](a-level/12-motion-in-a-circle.qmd)

- 12.1 Kinematics of uniform circular motion: radians, angular speed and $v=r\omega$
- 12.2 Centripetal acceleration and centripetal force
:::

::: {.topic-card}
### [13 Gravitational fields](a-level/13-gravitational-fields.qmd)

- 13.1–13.4: fields, Newtonian gravitation, point-mass fields and potential
- Circular and geostationary orbits, potential-energy changes
:::

::: {.topic-card}
### [14 Temperature](a-level/14-temperature.qmd)

- 14.1–14.3: thermal equilibrium, thermometric properties and thermodynamic temperature
- Specific heat capacity and latent heat
:::

::: {.topic-card}
### [15 Ideal gases](a-level/15-ideal-gases.qmd)

- 15.1–15.3: the mole, ideal-gas equations and kinetic-theory assumptions
- Molecular pressure, r.m.s. speed and translational kinetic energy
:::

::: {.topic-card}
### [16 Thermodynamics](a-level/16-thermodynamics.qmd)

- 16.1–16.2: internal energy, molecular kinetic and potential energies
- Constant-pressure work and the first law
:::

::: {.topic-card}
### [17 Oscillations](a-level/17-oscillations.qmd)

- 17.1–17.3: simple harmonic motion, SHM energy, damping and resonance
- Forced oscillations and resonance
:::

::: {.topic-card}
### [18 Electric fields](a-level/18-electric-fields.qmd)

- 18.1–18.5: field lines, uniform fields, Coulomb's law and point-charge fields
- Electric potential and potential energy
:::

::: {.topic-card}
### [19 Capacitance](a-level/19-capacitance.qmd)

- 19.1–19.3: capacitance, capacitor combinations and stored energy
- Time constant and exponential discharge
:::

::: {.topic-card}
### [20 Magnetic fields](a-level/20-magnetic-fields.qmd)

- 20.1–20.5: magnetic forces, Hall effect, fields due to currents and flux
- Electromagnetic induction
:::

::: {.topic-card}
### [21 Alternating currents](a-level/21-alternating-currents.qmd)

- 21.1–21.2: sinusoidal supplies, r.m.s. values and power
- Rectification and smoothing
:::

::: {.topic-card}
### [22 Quantum physics](a-level/22-quantum-physics.qmd)

- 22.1–22.4: photons, the photoelectric effect and wave-particle duality
- Atomic energy levels and line spectra
:::

::: {.topic-card}
### [23 Nuclear physics](a-level/23-nuclear-physics.qmd)

- 23.1–23.2: mass defect, binding energy, fission and fusion
- Radioactive decay
:::

::: {.topic-card}
### [24 Medical physics](a-level/24-medical-physics.qmd)

- 24.1–24.3: ultrasound transducers and imaging, X-ray production and CT
- PET scanning
:::

::: {.topic-card}
### [25 Astronomy and cosmology](a-level/25-astronomy-and-cosmology.qmd)

- 25.1–25.3: standard candles, stellar radii, redshift and Hubble's law
- The Big Bang theory
:::
